ic_name: LIN bus 2.2A (Local Interconnect Network, LIN Consortium)
test_debug_features: Internal loopback (MCR.LOOP=1) for fault isolation; SOUT internally drives SIN; modem outputs drive modem inputs.
Break, parity, overrun, framing error simulation through loopback + register manipulation.
FIFO reset bits (FCR.RX_FIFO_RESET, FCR.TX_FIFO_RESET) for in-chip BIST equivalent.
Complete LSR status reporting allows software self-test of all framing / error paths.
Master Reset (MR pin) sets a known reset state per Table I.

spec_provided_observability.name: LSR.DR
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Data Ready — character available in RBR / RX FIFO.

spec_provided_observability.name: LSR.RFE
spec_provided_observability.purpose: RX FIFO contains at least one error (FIFO mode).

spec_provided_observability.name: IIR
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Identifies highest-priority pending interrupt + FIFO-enabled status.

spec_provided_observability.name: MSR delta bits
spec_provided_observability.purpose: DCTS / DDSR / TERI / DDCD record modem-input transitions since last read.

interrupt_sources.trigger: RX data available or FIFO trigger level reached.
Character timeout — RX FIFO non-empty + no new char within 4 character times.

interrupt_request: INTR pin (active HIGH) is the OR of all enabled interrupt sources; IIR identifies the highest-priority pending source.
notes: LIN is intentionally designed so that a single-bit response_error signal suffices to perform a conformance test of the frame transceiver (the protocol engine) independent of the application and the signal interaction layer (section 2.7.3).
self_check_mechanisms: Monitoring — transmitters compare bit levels driven to bus levels detected.
Bit Stuffing — detect 6 consecutive identical bits in stuffed fields = STUFF ERROR.
Message Frame Check — fixed-form fields (CRC DELIMITER, ACK DELIMITER, EOF, INTERMISSION) checked for illegal bits = FORM ERROR.

error_count_thresholds.consequence: Diagnostic warning — heavily disturbed bus (note in spec).

recovery_from_bus_off: After 128 occurrences of 11 consecutive recessive bits on the bus, a bus-off node is permitted to become error-active again (error counts both reset to 0).

response_error_truth_table.interpretation: the slave node is operating correctly
the slave node has intermittent problems

response_error_truth_table.response_error_value: the slave node did not answer
response_error_truth_table.interpretation: the slave node, bus or master node has serious problems

interrupt_sources_node_level.purpose: Synchronise UART to master's bit time; reset slave frame processor.
Pull byte; if part of a frame body process; if standalone outside Active state ignore.
Update Successful_transfer or Error_in_response; possibly clear response_error.
Exit Bus sleep mode → Initializing → Operational.

interrupt_request_summary: LIN does not define a hardware INTR line at the protocol level — interrupts are entirely vendor-microcontroller-side (UART RX, UART TX, timer for slot boundaries, transceiver wake pin).
